sections.section_title: Salary Acquisition > Terms and Conditions > 1. Sector Categories
sections.content: • Public Sector, Security Forces, Military, Intelligence Services, Customs • Retirees • Approved Private Sector • Non-Approved Private Sector

content_blocks.label: 1. Sector Categories
items: Public Sector, Security Forces, Military, Intelligence Services, Customs

sections.section_title: Salary Acquisition > Terms and Conditions > 2. Age Criteria
sections.content: • Minimum age: 25 years • Maximum age: 50 years

sections.section_title: Salary Acquisition > Terms and Conditions > 3. Minimum Income
sections.content: • 1,000 JOD minimum salary • No maximum limit

sections.section_title: Salary Acquisition > Terms and Conditions > 4. Minimum Employment Period
sections.content: • Public sector: 6 months • Retirees: one-month salary receipt condition • Approved private sector: 6 months • Non-approved private sector: 24 months

sections.section_title: Salary Acquisition > Terms and Conditions > 5. Job Restrictions
sections.content: Excluded roles: • Service employees (e.g., cleaners, messengers, drivers, etc.) • Municipal workers • Daily wage workers

content_blocks.label: Excluded roles
items: Service employees (e.g., cleaners, messengers, drivers, etc.)

sections.section_title: Salary Acquisition > Terms and Conditions > 6. Incentives (Cash Bonus)
sections.content: Based on net salary: Net Salary Range Cash Reward 1,000 – 2,999 JOD 250 JOD 3,000 – 11,999 JOD 750 JOD 12,000+ JOD 2,000 JOD • Bonus is doubled if the customer obtains a loan equal to at least 10 times the salary for customers with a net salary ranging from 1,000 JOD to 11,999 JOD only .

content_blocks.text: Based on net salary: Net Salary Range Cash Reward 1,000 – 2,999 JOD 250 JOD 3,000 – 11,999 JOD 750 JOD 12,000+ JOD 2,000 JOD

content_blocks.label: Items
items: Bonus is doubled if the customer obtains a loan equal to at least 10 times the salary for customers with a net salary ranging from 1,000 JOD to 11,999 JOD only .

sections.section_title: Salary Acquisition > Terms and Conditions > 7. Commitment Period
sections.content: • Customer must commit to salary transfer for at least 3 years . • If salary transfer stops during this period: o The bank has the right to reclaim the full cash bonus.

content_blocks.label: 7. Commitment Period
items: Customer must commit to salary transfer for at least 3 years .
If salary transfer stops during this period: o The bank has the right to reclaim the full cash bonus.

sections.section_title: Salary Acquisition > Terms and Conditions > 8. Cash Bonus Disbursement Method
sections.content: • Bonus is paid via: o Issuing a credit card with a salary-based limit o Crediting the bonus amount to the customer’s credit card account after conditions are met

content_blocks.label: 8. Cash Bonus Disbursement Method
items: Bonus is paid via: o Issuing a credit card with a salary-based limit o Crediting the bonus amount to the customer’s credit card account after conditions are met

sections.section_title: Salary Acquisition > Terms and Conditions > 9. Credit Card Limit
sections.content: • Based on salary • Maximum limit: 5,000 JOD • Total obligations must not exceed 50% debt burden • If higher limit is requested: o Full credit card documentation is required according to card program policies

content_blocks.label: 9. Credit Card Limit
items: Total obligations must not exceed 50% debt burden
If higher limit is requested: o Full credit card documentation is required according to card program policies

sections.section_title: Salary Acquisition > Terms and Conditions > 10. Required Documents
sections.content: • Salary transfer undertaking + end-of-service benefits assignment (approved bank format) • Latest salary slip (last month) • Social Security statement (for non-approved companies)

content_blocks.label: 10. Required Documents
items: Salary transfer undertaking + end-of-service benefits assignment (approved bank format)

sections.section_title: Salary Acquisition > Terms and Conditions > 11. Program Conditions
sections.content: • Customer must sign a 3-year salary transfer commitment • Bonus is only paid after receiving a minimum salary of 1,000 JOD • Program applies only to new salary transfer customers o Existing salary-transfer customers are excluded • No bonus doubling for: o Cash collateral loans only o Loans less than 10x salary • Excluded categories: o Retirement salary beneficiaries (heirs) o NGO employees

content_blocks.label: 11. Program Conditions
items: Customer must sign a 3-year salary transfer commitment
Bonus is only paid after receiving a minimum salary of 1,000 JOD
Program applies only to new salary transfer customers o Existing salary-transfer customers are excluded
No bonus doubling for: o Cash collateral loans only o Loans less than 10x salary
Excluded categories: o Retirement salary beneficiaries (heirs) o NGO employees
